ME_DESC: Manage your profile, preferences, and security settings.
ME_PROFILE_DISPLAY_NAME_INVALID: Only letters, numbers, underscore, CJK characters, spaces, dots and hyphens are allowed.
ME_PROFILE_DISPLAY_NAME_CONFIRM_DESC: This will update how your name appears across the product.
ME_PROFILE_EMAIL_DIALOG_DESC: Changing email requires verifying the new address.
ME_PROFILE_EMAIL_NEW_EMAIL_INVALID: Please enter a valid email address
ME_LINKED_ACCOUNTS_EMPTY: No third-party sign-in providers are available.
ME_LINKED_ACCOUNTS_DISCONNECT_CONFIRM: Disconnect this provider? You may not be able to sign in with it afterward.
ME_DELETE_ACCOUNT_DESC: We'll be sorry to see you go, but thanks for trying! Deleting your account is permanent. All your data will be wiped out immediately and you won't be able to get it back.
ME_DELETE_ACCOUNT_DIALOG_DESC: Please confirm your password to continue.
ME_DELETE_ACCOUNT_ALERT_DESC: Deleting your account will permanently remove access. Some data may remain for audit and integrity, but personal details will be anonymized.
ME_DELETE_ACCOUNT_CONFIRM_EMAIL_INVALID: Please enter a valid email address
ME_PREF_LOCALIZATION_PANEL_DESC: Effective priority: User > Workspace > Organization > Browser. User preference defaults to empty.
ME_PREF_NOTIFICATIONS_PANEL_PIN_DESC: Keep the panel pinned when opened.
ME_PREF_MOTION_REDUCE_DESC: Reduce animations and transitions. System setting is always respected.
ME_PREF_NAV_BADGE_DESC: Display unread count badge for the notifications menu item in the sidebar.
ME_PREF_CONTRAST_DESC: Improve readability by increasing the contrast of text and borders.
ME_PREF_TEXT_SIZE_DESC: Adjust the interface text size. This only affects typography, not layout spacing.
ME_PREF_TEXT_SIZE_ALERT_DESC: This value may reduce readability and cause truncation in dense layouts.
ME_PREF_TEXT_WEIGHT_ALERT_DESC: This value may reduce readability in long-form content.
ME_PREF_TIMEZONE_DESC: When not set, the app follows workspace/organization defaults and then falls back to the browser.
ME_PREF_LANGUAGE_DESC: Choose how the interface language is resolved.
ME_SECURITY_CHANGE_PASSWORD_DIALOG_DESC: Enter your current password and choose a new password.
ME_SECURITY_PASSWORD_CHANGE_FAILED: Update failed. Please check your current password and try again.
ME_SECURITY_SESSIONS_TABLE_DESC: Session management will be fully available soon.
ME_SECURITY_SIGNIN_DISABLED_DESC: Sign-in method management is not available yet.
ME_NOTIFY_CHANNEL_IN_APP_DESC: In-app delivery is not enabled yet (locked).
ME_NOTIFY_EMAIL_PANEL_DESC: Security events must keep at least one channel enabled. Since in-app delivery is not enabled, security email notifications stay on.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_PASSWORD_CHANGED_DESC: Notify me when my password is changed.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_EMAIL_CHANGED_DESC: Notify me when my email address is changed.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_NEW_LOGIN_DESC: Notify me when a new device or location signs in.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_TEAM_INVITE_DESC: Notify me when I receive a workspace invitation.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_ROLE_CHANGED_DESC: Notify me when my role or permissions change.
